title: University of California, Santa Cruz
description: UC Santa Cruz's official brand colour guidelines define the primary colours Primary Blue, PMS 541C (#003C6C) and Primary Yellow, PMS 116 (#FDC700), and the secondary colours PMS 300C (#006AAD), PMS 299C (#13A5DC), PMS 3145C (#007988), PMS 1375C (#F29813), PMS 1235C (#FFBF00), PMS 390C (#93C02D) and Rubine Red (#DA216D).
